WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    a.month,
    SUM(a.card_spend_eur) AS total_card_spend_eur,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active THEN a.user_id END) AS active_users,
    SUM(a.n_card_txns) AS card_txns,
    SUM(a.card_spend_eur) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active THEN a.user_id END),0) AS spend_per_active_user_eur,
    SUM(a.n_card_txns) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.is_active THEN a.user_id END),0) AS txns_per_active_user
  FROM fct_activity_monthly a
  JOIN dim_users u USING (user_id)
  WHERE u.country = 'RO'
    AND a.month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2026-05-01'
  GROUP BY 1
), stats AS (
  SELECT
    AVG(spend_per_active_user_eur) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2026-02-01') AS baseline_avg_spend_per_active,
    STDDEV_SAMP(spend_per_active_user_eur) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2026-02-01') AS baseline_sd_spend_per_active,
    AVG(txns_per_active_user) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2026-02-01') AS baseline_avg_txns_per_active,
    STDDEV_SAMP(txns_per_active_user) FILTER (WHERE month BETWEEN DATE '2024-01-01' AND DATE '2026-02-01') AS baseline_sd_txns_per_active
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT m.*, s.*
FROM monthly m CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE m.month IN (DATE '2026-03-01', DATE '2026-04-01', DATE '2026-05-01')
ORDER BY m.month
